assumptions: assumes access to a Snapdragon X machine, which is the real gate
no model training is implied by the capture
clone_cost.why: Vall-E-X and Whisper are available through the vendor's hub; the work is the quantisation pass and the Windows shell

prior_art.relation: same local-first bet on translation/dubbing; AudioNova optimises the silicon, Nua optimises the pipeline

what_breaks_first: Two things: cloning quality across accents and speakers, and the install base — Windows on Snapdragon X is a small denominator, so distribution breaks long before the models do. Voice cloning consent/retention is also unspecified in the page, which you must not inherit.
what_to_steal: Make the hardware path the product, not the fallback: quantise and route to DSP/GPU deliberately, then publish the delta against your own unoptimised path (2x speed, ~35% power) as the headline number instead of a model name.
worth_note: 547 likes and a staff feature on a Windows-on-Snapdragon app is not luck: it deletes the cloud bill, the latency and the privacy argument at once. Held back from 'breakthrough' because on-device TTS is a crowded field and the moat here is toolchain work (AI Hub quantisation), not a new capability.
